items.title: Existence for the valuative criterion implies that the morphism is universally closed

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks which satisfies the existence clause of the valuative criterion is universally closed (author lemma at source lines 9777-9786, label lemma-converse-existence-universally-closed). The proof (source lines 9788-9837) sets up the valuative diagram with a valuation ring, uses the base change behaviour of the category of dotted arrows to reduce the diagram, and obtains the dotted arrow from the hypothesis before concluding by the corresponding statement for the reduced situation (proof lines 9788-9836). The reduction of the valuative diagram and the reading of the hypothesis in the reduced form are the content. H3.
